text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) had 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Let's go, McQueen! Make it a three-peat!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You have to win, okay?! I'm so looking 
forward to seeing a new record!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro McQueen is someone who has already 
achieved back-to-back victories in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why no one imagines a 
'miracle' where someone actually defeats 
her."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far behind Rice falls in a 
race, Rice won't give up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who invited everyone, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because everyone's just way too fast~! 
Whew!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Do your best today too, Rice-chan! I'll be 
cheering for you from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm looking forward to it. To the 
moment you bloom into a blue rose, 
Rice-san."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What is expected of you this time is 
victory, not defeat.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Alright then. Dear brother, everyone! 
...I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Alright then. Dear sister, everyone! 
...I'm off!
